description: NaAgS₂O₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.71 Å. Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent S and one O atom. There are a spread of Ag-S bond distances ranging from 2.45-3.00 Å. The Ag-O bond length is 2.81 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Ag and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.11 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.46 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ag, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom.
